evidence.title: fix(cua): preserve Linux observations and REPL diagnostics by DragonnZhang · Pull Request #11829 · QwenLM/qwen-code · GitHub

name: fix(cua): preserve Linux observations and REPL diagnostics
summary: Merged pull request in QwenLM/qwen-code: preserves Linux accessibility observation indices and Node REPL diagnostics in computer-use runs.
description: Merged pull request (#11829) in QwenLM/qwen-code: preserves Linux accessibility element indices across window observations so returned tokens resolve to the observed controls, keeps usable observation history under element or depth limits, returns processes that own top-level windows in app discovery and reports an actionable X11 error; Node REPL preserves bounded error codes and recovery details through MCP, and cancellation gets a host-enforced five-second deadline.
